source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When modifying Thunderbird Marionette coverage, check the default, Windows and macOS mozharness configurations. Commit 260 adds unittests/thunderbird_extra.py to all three; adding a generic test task does not itself add Thunderbird-specific coverage settings. Marionette covers startup, shutdown, sessionstore and command-line behavior that other harnesses may not reach. Current accepted marionette.yml retains the Thunderbird config. This study did not run CI.
title: Marionette coverage needs Thunderbird config in each platform branch
